name: test-driven-development
title_zh: 先写红再写绿的测试驱动开发执行器
tagline_zh: 改代码前先让测试失败一次，再写实现让它通过。适合被回归 bug 追着跑、又总在补测试的你。
tagline_en: Make tests fail before writing code, then watch them pass. For developers tired of regression bugs and skipped.
desc_en: Use when implementing any feature or bugfix, before writing implementation code
why_zh: 它把 TDD 从口号变成强制流程：先红后绿，再重构。不是提醒你写测试，而是拦在你写实现代码之前。
why_en: It enforces TDD as a hard gate: red first, green second, refactor third. Not a reminder—it blocks implementation until failing.
limit_zh: 只认测试框架的失败/通过状态，不识别测试质量；不覆盖重构阶段；对已有代码库的存量功能不生效，只拦新改动。
limit_en: Only checks test pass/fail status, not test quality; no refactoring phase; applies to new changes only, not legacy code; requires test command.
title_en: Test-Driven Development Executor: Red First, Then Green
